title: USGS Watershed Boundaries
description: A cloud-native GeoParquet, PMTiles, and H3 mirror of the USGS Watershed Boundary Dataset (WBD): a seamless, nested hierarchy of U.S. hydrologic units from 22 HUC2 regions down to over 103,000 HUC12 subwatersheds, with codes that nest as prefixes across levels.

## README.md
# USGS Watershed Boundary Dataset (WBD) — National HUC2–HUC12

Cloud-native mirror of the [USGS Watershed Boundary Dataset](https://www.usgs.gov/national-hydrography/watershed-boundary-dataset):
a seamless, nested hierarchy of hydrologic units for the United States and territories, from **HUC2 regions**
down to **HUC12 subwatersheds**.

- **Source:** USGS National Hydrography Program — national seamless WBD File Geodatabase
  (`WBD_National_GDB.zip`, updated 2025-01-07). **Public domain** (US Government work).
- **CRS:** OGC:CRS84 (longitude, latitude).
- **Bucket:** `s3://public-usgs-wbd/` · public URL base `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usgs-wbd/`

| Level | Unit | Code column | Features | GeoParquet | PMTiles | H3 hex |
|------:|------|-------------|---------:|:----------:|:-------:|:------:|
| HUC2  | Region       | `huc2`  |      22 | ✅ | ✅ | — |
| HUC4  | Subregion    | `huc4`  |     245 | ✅ | ✅ | — |
| HUC6  | Basin        | `huc6`  |     407 | ✅ | ✅ | — |
| HUC8  | Subbasin     | `huc8`  |   2,456 | ✅ | ✅ | — |
| HUC10 | Watershed    | `huc10` |  18,911 | ✅ | ✅ | — |
| HUC12 | Subwatershed | `huc12` | 103,068 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ (res 8) |

**HUC codes nest:** a HUC12 code contains its parents as prefixes — `180701050402` →
HUC2 `18`, HUC4 `1807`, HUC6 `180701`, HUC8 `18070105`, HUC10 `1807010504`. So the single HUC12 hex
layer answers "what watershed is this point in?" at *every* level.

## Files

```
public-usgs-wbd/
├── wbd/hu2.parquet   wbd/hu2.pmtiles    wbd/hu2/stac-collection.json
├── wbd/hu4.parquet   wbd/hu4.pmtiles    wbd/hu4/stac-collection.json
├── wbd/hu6.parquet   wbd/hu6.pmtiles    wbd/hu6/stac-collection.json
├── wbd/hu8.parquet   wbd/hu8.pmtiles    wbd/hu8/stac-collection.json
├── wbd/hu10.parquet  wbd/hu10.pmtiles   wbd/hu10/stac-collection.json
├── wbd/hu12.parquet  wbd/hu12.pmtiles   wbd/hu12/stac-collection.json
│   └── wbd/hu12/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet           (H3 res-8, hive-partitioned by h0)
├── stac-collection.json
└── README.md
```

## DuckDB — query the GeoParquet

```sql
INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;

-- All HUC2 regions
SELECT huc2, name, areasqkm
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usgs-wbd/wbd/hu2.parquet')
ORDER BY huc2;

-- Which HUC12 subwatershed contains a point (point-in-polygon, exact)?
SELECT huc12, name, states
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usgs-wbd/wbd/hu12.parquet')
WHERE ST_Contains(shape, ST_Point(-118.2974, 34.0369));
-- → 180701040300  Ballona Creek  CA
```

## DuckDB — point-in-watershed via H3 hex (fast, no geometry)

```sql
INSTALL h3 FROM community; LOAD h3;

-- Look up the watershed for a lat/lon by its H3 res-8 cell
WITH pt AS (SELECT h3_latlng_to_cell(34.0369, -118.2974, 8) AS h8)
SELECT DISTINCT hex.huc12, hex.name,
       hex.huc12[1:2]   AS huc2,   -- parents are just prefixes
       hex.huc12[1:8]   AS huc8
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usgs-wbd/wbd/hu12/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet') hex, pt
WHERE hex.h8 = pt.h8;
```

> **Never `SUM` per-feature columns on the hex layer.** `areasqkm`, `areaacres`, `shape_Area`,
> `shape_Length`, and the non-contributing-area columns are the subwatershed's totals, repeated on every
> hex row it covers. For area, use `COUNT(DISTINCT h8) × cell_area_at_resolution_8`, or
> `SELECT DISTINCT huc12, areasqkm` before aggregating. The H3 index columns (`h8`, `h0`) are safe to aggregate.

## MapLibre GL JS — display boundaries

The PMTiles `source-layer` is the level id (`hu2` … `hu12`), **not** the GDB layer name.

```js
import { Protocol } from 'pmtiles';
maplibregl.addProtocol('pmtiles', new Protocol().tile);

map.addSource('wbd-hu12', {
  type: 'vector',
  url: 'pmtiles://https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usgs-wbd/wbd/hu12.pmtiles'
});
map.addLayer({
  id: 'subwatersheds',
  type: 'line',
  source: 'wbd-hu12',
  'source-layer': 'hu12',     // ← last path segment of the dataset
  paint: { 'line-color': '#2b6cb0', 'line-width': 0.5 }
});
```

## Attributes

Every level carries `huc{N}`, `name`, `areasqkm`/`areaacres`, `states` (comma-separated postal codes),
and source-provenance fields (`tnmid`, `loaddate`, `globalid`, …). Local levels add:

- **HUC10 & HUC12:** `hutype` (S=Standard, C=Closed Basin, F=Frontal, M=Multiple Outlet, W=Water, I=Island,
  U=Urban, D=Indeterminate) and `humod` (modification codes; `NM`=No Modification).
- **HUC12 only:** `tohuc` (downstream HUC12 for surface-flow routing) and non-contributing-area columns.

See each level's `stac-collection.json` for full per-column documentation.

## Provenance & processing

Converted from the USGS national WBD GDB with [`cng-datasets`](https://github.com/boettiger-lab/datasets)
(DuckDB-native GeoParquet, `tippecanoe` PMTiles, H3 polyfill for hex). Source CRS `EPSG:5498`
(NAD83 + NAVD88 height) reprojected to OGC:CRS84. Public domain — free to use, share, and adapt.
